chart.programText:
A = data('container/network/received_bytes_count', filter=filter('service', 'run'), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).sum(by=['service_name']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).mean().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (B).timeshift('1d').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (B/C-1).scale(100).publish(label='D')
